name: Point-based Projected Tetrahedra
aliases: Point-Based Volume Rendering of Tetrahedral Meshes
definition: A rendering technique for unstructured tetrahedral meshes that represents each tetrahedron as a single rasterized square (point primitive) carrying a single scalar value, decoupling footprint generation and reshaping from the compositing stage.
summary: Point-based Projected Tetrahedra is a hardware-assisted volume rendering technique that approximates tetrahedral meshes with points to avoid connectivity processing and convolution, ensuring robustness against malformed elements.
